# Drug Patent Watch

> > Comprehensive pharmaceutical patent intelligence tracking drug patents, biologics licenses (BLA), NDA approvals, and patent expiration dates for branded and generic drugs worldwide.

Drug Patent Watch provides patent databases and pipeline tracking for pharmaceutical companies including major players like Merck, Genentech, Bristol Myers Squibb, Takeda, and emerging biotech firms. The platform monitors FDA approvals, PTAB proceedings, patent status, and expiration timelines for both small molecule drugs and biologics across global markets.

## Key Topics

- BLA (Biologics License Application)
- NDA (New Drug Application)
- Patent expiration tracking
- PTAB (Patent Trial and Appeal Board)
- Biosimilars and biologics
- Generic drug approvals
- Branded pharmaceutical patents
- FDA approval status
- Drug pipeline intelligence
- Patent litigation
- Orange Book listings
- Purple Book biologics
- Pharmaceutical patent databases
- Drug exclusivity periods
- Patent term extensions

## Major Pharmaceutical Companies

- [MERCK drug pipeline, global patents](https://www.drugpatentwatch.com/p/biologics/applicant/Merck): Merck biologics patent database: antivenin, BLA filings, expiration dates
- [GENENTECH branded and generic drugs, international patents](https://www.drugpatentwatch.com/p/biologics/applicant/Genentech): Genentech biologics: NUTROPIN, somatropin, BLA patent database
- [BRISTOL MYERS SQUIBB branded and generic drugs, global patents](https://www.drugpatentwatch.com/p/biologics/applicant/Bristol+Myers+Squibb): Bristol Myers Squibb biologics: BLA applications, patent expiration data
- [TAKEDA PHARMACEUTICALS AMERICA, INC. branded and generic drugs, international patents](https://www.drugpatentwatch.com/p/biologics/applicant/Takeda+Pharmaceuticals+America%2C+Inc.): Takeda Pharmaceuticals biologics: BLA listings, patent database
- [TEVA BRANDED PHARM drug patent status, global patents](https://www.drugpatentwatch.com/p/applicant/Teva+Branded+Pharm): Teva Branded patents: AUSTEDO, VANTRELA ER, deutetrabenazine
- [SUN PHARM branded and generic drugs, global patents](https://www.drugpatentwatch.com/p/applicant/Sun+Pharm): Sun Pharma patent database: branded/generic drugs, NDA approvals
